macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks finish lower as Nvidia selloff weighs on indexes
items.summary: The Dow fell 0.36% to 52,297.09, the S&P 500 declined 0.35% to 7,592.40, and the Nasdaq Composite dropped 0.39% to 25,366.09. Nvidia fell 4.3%, while rising oil prices and Middle East tensions added to risk-off sentiment.[4]

items.title: Fed officials signal continued concern about inflation
items.summary: New York Fed President John Williams said the central bank still has work to do to return inflation to target. San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly said additional tightening could be necessary as firms signal plans to pass higher input costs to consumers.[1][4]

items.title: Oil prices jump amid Middle East tensions
items.summary: U.S. crude rose 2.55% to $88.74 a barrel, while Brent gained 3.3% to $95.82, increasing concerns that energy costs could prolong inflationary pressure and complicate the Federal Reserve’s policy outlook.[4]

items.title: Cisco beats earnings expectations and raises outlook
items.summary: Cisco reported stronger-than-expected results and lifted its fiscal-year 2027 outlook, with revenue from hyperscale customers expected to more than double. Its shares rose about 4% in the session.[2]

items.title: Cerebras shares surge on upbeat annual forecast
items.summary: Cerebras shares jumped 17% after the artificial-intelligence chip company issued a stronger annual forecast, helping ease some investor concern about the outlook for AI-related stocks.[2]

items.title: AstraZeneca announces $2.5 billion China investment
items.summary: AstraZeneca said it will invest $2.5 billion in a Beijing research and development center through partnerships with Chinese government entities and biotechnology companies.[3]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: U.S. Treasury plans custody framework for government-held Bitcoin
items.summary: The U.S. Treasury is reportedly developing standardized custody and control procedures for Bitcoin held by government agencies, including assets seized through law enforcement and Bitcoin designated for the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve.

items.title: Bitcoin falls below $71,000
items.summary: Bitcoin traded near $70,995.50, down about 1% over 24 hours, amid continued market weakness and reported large exchange inflows.

items.title: BNB drops below $650
items.summary: BNB fell below $650, trading around $649.63 and losing approximately 4.52% over 24 hours.

items.title: Ethereum open interest declines 5.24%
items.summary: Global Ethereum futures open interest fell 5.24% in 24 hours to approximately $23.85 billion, signaling reduced derivatives exposure.

items.title: Thailand proposes daily stablecoin transaction caps
items.summary: Thailand’s securities regulator reportedly plans separate daily limits for stablecoin deposits and withdrawals and would require customers to use wallets they control.

items.title: South Korea considers crypto withdrawal freezes during hacking threats
items.summary: South Korea is reportedly preparing measures that would allow crypto withdrawals to be frozen during suspected hacking incidents, following recent exchange security events.

items.title: Brazil says roughly 30% of crypto exchanges fail capital requirements
items.summary: Brazil’s central bank reportedly found that about 30% of crypto exchanges do not meet applicable capital requirements, highlighting regulatory and solvency concerns in the sector.

items.title: Zano restarts blockchain after gateway-address flaw
items.summary: Zano restarted its chain after a vulnerability allowed unauthorized ZANO and fUSD issuance; users must upgrade software to follow the recovered chain.

items.title: Quant token jumps after tokenized-deposit partnership
items.summary: QNT rose about 36% after The Clearing House selected Quant to provide the interoperability layer for a bank-led U.S. tokenized-deposit network.

items.title: Bitget confirms $351.6 million wallet breach
items.summary: Bitget confirmed that a breach affected its hot and warm wallets, while cold storage remained secure; the exchange reportedly established a $464 million fund to cover the loss.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Xbox announces Wolfenstein 3
items.summary: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma confirmed that Wolfenstein 3 is officially in production at MachineGames, marking the return of the id Software-created franchise after Wolfenstein II: The New Colossus.

items.title: GDC report finds widespread layoffs and unemployment
items.summary: The 15th State of the Game Industry report says 34% of surveyed developers were laid off during the past 24 months, while 21% are currently unemployed. More than half of laid-off workers surveyed have not yet found another job.

items.title: Le Mans Ultimate surpasses two million unit sales
items.summary: Motorsport Games reported that Le Mans Ultimate has exceeded two million combined sales of its base game and downloadable content. The racing game also reached a record 11,941 concurrent players during an October special event.

items.title: Escape from Tarkov console version expected to be announced in 2027
items.summary: Battlestate Games is reportedly working toward bringing Escape from Tarkov to consoles and is seeking a partner to help facilitate the port. An official announcement is expected in 2027, according to the report.

items.title: GTA 6 anticipation intensifies ahead of release
items.summary: With Grand Theft Auto VI scheduled for release on November 19, the game is generating unusually broad attention across gaming, entertainment, and popular culture as analysts anticipate a major commercial and cultural impact.
